component.name: network
component.description: TAPPaaS module network: triage of its own critical/high CVEs (#788).

analysis.detail: Heap overflow in RRSet canonicalisation from a 255-byte query name and a large TCP response. unbound on the firewall is a full recursive resolver for every zone (forwards only internal and 10.in-addr.arpa to dnsmasq), so any internal client looking up an attacker's domain makes unbound read the attacker's own DNS server's responses. Fixed in unbound 1.26.1; OPNsense 26.1.11_10 ships 1.25.1 and its channel offers nothing newer yet.

ratings.justification: risk in this deployment, from the triage

Fixed in unbound 1.26.1; OPNsense 26.1.11_10 ships 1.25.1 and its channel offers nothing newer yet.

analysis.detail: Outgoing query source-port entropy weakened where upstream load balancing depends on it: cache poisoning of the site's recursive resolver. unbound on the firewall is a full recursive resolver for every zone (forwards only internal and 10.in-addr.arpa to dnsmasq), so any internal client looking up an attacker's domain makes unbound read the attacker's own DNS server's responses.

analysis.detail: Unbounded consecutive reads on a TCP/DoT connection: denial of service of the resolver, by a client inside the site (port 53 on the internal zones).
